integrity: Scientific proof includes transition recurrences for every size; exact fraction program checks labeled graph states through size six and recurrences through size 45; finite checks do not substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact annealed one-vertex degree marginals in the known true/false-twin cograph process; no quenched empirical degree-law claim, joint law, or general graph-model claim. Complete labeled-graph probabilities were already known; exact marginal simplification and age contrast are the specified claim. Historical priority could be affected by broader results on cloning graphs.
title: Exact beta-binomial degrees and all-size uniformity in recursively grown cographs
